title: The Stuff You Should Know 2016 Christmas Extravaganza in 3-D!
summary: Stuff You Should Know's 2016 Christmas special, a holiday-themed episode of festive trivia and traditions. Covers Catalan poop-log tradition Cagatillo and the Cagàner figurines; Krampus, the Austrian/Alpine Christmas demon, and the Greek Kallikantzaros; Danny the South African ghost boy legend; the making of A Charlie Brown Christmas (1965) and its history; a Jamaican sorrel punch recipe; the history of Mrs. Claus, including James Rees's 1849 story; a Charity Hutchinson post on telling kids about Santa by recasting them as a Santa; and listener-submitted unusual family Christmas traditions. Ends with a birthday shout-out and holiday sign-off.
topics: Danny the South African ghost boy

segments.title: Holiday welcome and opening banter
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck welcome listeners to the 2016 Christmas special, joke about smellovision, and set the festive mood.

segments.title: Catalan poop-log and Cagáner traditions
segments.summary: The hosts describe the Catalan Cagatillo log tradition, including feeding it and beating it with sticks to get gifts, and the Cagáner pooping figurines placed in Nativity scenes. They mention a 2010 record-setting figurine in Barcelona.

segments.title: Ad-free note
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh note the Christmas episode is ad free by tradition.

segments.title: Krampus and Christmas demons
segments.summary: Krampus, the horned Alpine companion of Saint Nicholas who punishes bad children, is described along with his history of attempted bans, and the Greek Kallikantzaros legend and the South African Danny ghost story.
topics: Danny the South African ghost boy

segments.title: History of A Charlie Brown Christmas
segments.summary: The hosts cover how the 1965 Charlie Brown Christmas special came about from a Lee Mendelson documentary, its music by Vince Guaraldi, its child voice cast, the network's objections, its ratings success, and the cut Coca-Cola and snowball scenes restored in 1997.

segments.title: Jamaican sorrel punch recipe
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck discuss sorrel, a hibiscus-family flower that is not the common hibiscus, and walk through a recipe for a cold Jamaican sorrel punch with ginger, cloves, cinnamon, simple syrup, and amber rum.

segments.title: Mrs. Claus origins and naming
segments.summary: The hosts trace Mrs. Claus to James Rees's 1849 story The Christmas Legend, note she has no official first name, and joke about candidate names.

segments.title: Telling kids the truth about Santa
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh discuss Charity Hutchinson's viral Facebook idea of telling children they can become Santa by secretly giving gifts, and other parents' approaches of describing Santa as a construct or spirit.

segments.title: Listener unusual family Christmas traditions
segments.summary: Listeners submitted unusual family traditions: a Polish pauper's meal, the hidden pickle ornament contest, a Barbie creative gift card, weird wrapping paper, Australian beach breakfast of champagne and cherries, the ba humbug can, the ice cream eating contest, a signed tablecloth, a wind-up ET doll, sleeping by the tree, a Christmas rutabaga, and Pajamaicas.

segments.title: Birthday shout-out and sign-off
segments.summary: Chuck gives a birthday shout-out to listener Gail Coots and the hosts wish listeners happy holidays.
